costs.basis: Known conservative recorded usage estimates, not invoices.
costs.prior_P8_and_control_and_Luna_costs: Preserved in prior producer receipts, not charged again in this addition.

interpretation_limits: Selected on these development data; no fidelity winner or final confirmation.
High generic control accuracy limits discrimination of personal-profile value.
Same-model joint extraction and consumption confound their separate effects.
P7 uses target-plus-peer fit evidence; P3/P8 target-only. No cross-method equal-evidence claim.
Historical aliases add no calls or independent observations. Keep cross-view duplicates out of pooled denominators.
Semantic retrieval order comparisons may change retrieval content, not solely consumer option positions.
Consumer caps and parent rendering failures measure delivery feasibility separately from prediction quality.
